newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH MARCH BUILDING PERMITS UP 43 PCT YR/YR - SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH MARCH BUILDING PERMITS UP 43 PCT YR/YR - SF.

text.p: The construction volume for which new building permits were granted rose 43 percent year-on-year in March to 2.5 million cubic metres, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Thursday.
The number of home building permits was one fourth higher than a year ago, and the volume of building space for which industrial building permits was granted doubled, SF said.
In January-March, new building permits were granted for a total of six million cubic metres of construction volume, or one fifth more than in the same period a year ago, SF said.
Building permits were granted for a total of 6,000 new dwellings in January-March, that is 2,500 more than in the same period last year, SF said
